disclaimer: Pricing and features are verified from official competitor documentation as of October 5, 2026. Competitor offerings and pricing may change.

competitors.name: Sort Feed

pricing.freeTier: Latest 25 posts or 1 week of content, all sorts (including Outlier Score), exports, downloads
pricing.paidFeatures: Up to 1,000 posts / full channel history, custom counts & date ranges, 500 minutes transcription/month

features.historicalDepth: Free: 25 posts; Pro: Up to 1,000 posts
features.accountRequired: Free: No account; Pro: Sort Feed account
features.executionModel: Client-side browser extension (transcription uses external server)

strengths: Broader multi-platform coverage including TikTok and Facebook alongside Instagram and YouTube
Deep historical batch analysis (up to 1,000 posts on Pro)
Built-in audio transcription (500 minutes/month on Pro)
Custom date range filtering
limitations: Free tier is restricted to 25 posts or 1 week of visible content
Deeper historical scanning and transcription require a paid subscription ($10–$15/mo)
Transcription sends audio to an external cloud transcription service
competitors.bestFor: Creators, agencies, and researchers who need TikTok and Facebook research in addition to Instagram/YouTube, require deeper batches (>25 posts), or need audio transcription.
competitors.notBestFor: Creators looking for 100% free, unlimited outlier analysis strictly focused on Instagram and YouTube.

competitors.name: Socialinsider
competitors.category: Social Media Analytics & Competitive Benchmarking Platform

pricing.freeTier: 14-day free trial only (no permanent free tier)
pricing.paidFeatures: Competitor benchmarking, automated PDF reporting, multi-year historical data, sentiment analysis

features.outlierScore: No dedicated post-level Outlier Score multiplier (uses average benchmark ratios)
features.accountRequired: Yes (Socialinsider dashboard account & profile tracking setup)
features.executionModel: Cloud-based dashboard querying cached platform APIs

strengths: Comprehensive multi-brand tracking across 6 major networks
Automated white-label PDF/Excel reports for agencies and clients
Long-term multi-year historical trend tracking
Cross-industry benchmark indices
limitations: High subscription cost starting at $82–$99/month with no permanent free tier
Requires creating a dashboard account, configuring brands, and waiting for data ingestion
Lacks immediate in-browser content-level outlier multipliers when browsing creator feeds
competitors.bestFor: Enterprise marketing teams and agencies needing automated monthly client reports, cross-network competitor benchmarking, and long-term historical brand tracking.
competitors.notBestFor: Individual creators and video editors who just want quick, free, on-page outlier discovery while browsing creator feeds.

competitors.name: Metricool
competitors.category: All-in-One Social Media Management & Publishing Suite

pricing.freeTier: Permanent free tier (1 brand, 20 scheduled posts/month, analysis of up to 5 competitor profiles)
pricing.paidFeatures: Unlimited post scheduling, team roles, up to 50 competitors, automated reporting, ad management

features.outlierScore: No (standard metric ranking without creator-relative median multipliers)
features.historicalDepth: Free: 3 months; Paid: Unlimited historical data
features.accountRequired: Yes (Metricool account and connected social accounts)

strengths: Complete publishing workflow: visual content calendar, automated multi-platform scheduling, and auto-publishing
Unified social inbox for comments and direct messages
Ad campaign management across Meta and Google
Generous free tier for solo social media managers
limitations: Free tier limits competitor tracking to 5 profiles total
Competitor research requires manual account addition in the dashboard rather than instant on-page browsing
Does not compute creator-relative Outlier Scores for specific video hooks
competitors.bestFor: Social media managers and creators who need an affordable, all-in-one publishing calendar, scheduler, and cross-channel management platform.
competitors.notBestFor: Creators looking for dedicated, rapid competitor content research to reverse-engineer viral hooks across dozens of creators.

competitors.name: Viewstats
competitors.category: Dedicated YouTube Intelligence & Creator Analytics Platform

pricing.freeTier: Free search, channel overview, basic outlier detection, milestone projections
pricing.yearlyPrice: Discounted annual billing available; Business starting at $249/mo
pricing.paidFeatures: Full historical outlier search, thumbnail comparison search, channel alerts, custom collections, API access

features.outlierScore: Yes (Viewstats Outlier score based on channel historical benchmarks)
features.executionModel: Web dashboard database plus companion Chrome extension

strengths: Unmatched YouTube-specific depth with massive historical channel index
Specialized thumbnail search and visual title/thumbnail comparison
Proactive channel alerts and custom tracking collections
A/B test detection and subscriber milestone analytics
limitations: Strictly limited to YouTube—zero support for Instagram Reels, Carousels, or posts
Advanced outlier search, collections, and alerts require a paid Pro/Business subscription ($49–$249/mo)
Heavier dashboard interface compared to a lightweight, on-page extension
competitors.bestFor: Dedicated YouTubers, thumbnail designers, and video production teams who exclusively produce YouTube content and need deep historical channel analytics.
competitors.notBestFor: Creators, agencies, or short-form editors who create content for both Instagram and YouTube and want a single unified research tool.

competitors.name: YouTube Studio

pricing.freeTier: 100% Free native tool for all YouTube channel owners and managers
pricing.paidFeatures: All features included for authenticated channel owners

features.outlierScore: No Outlier Score multiplier (shows ranking by views, e.g., '1 of 10' for latest upload)
features.contentDownloads: Yes (own video files can be downloaded)
features.transcription: Yes (automatic captions & subtitle editor for own videos)
features.accountRequired: Yes (Google account with channel owner or manager permissions)
features.executionModel: First-party Google web dashboard and mobile app

strengths: Direct access to private, ground-truth metrics: exact revenue, RPM/CPM, audience retention curves, and real-time views
Detailed traffic source breakdown (YouTube Search, Suggested, Browse Features, External)
Channel management capabilities: thumbnail uploading, title editing, monetization toggles, comment moderation
100% free with no usage limits or premium tiers
limitations: Cannot be used for competitor research: provides zero private metrics for other creators' channels
Lacks creator-relative Outlier Scores across full video catalogs
Does not support Instagram or any non-YouTube platform
competitors.bestFor: Every YouTube creator analyzing their own channel's private performance, audience retention drop-offs, and revenue.
competitors.notBestFor: Competitor research, niche exploration, or analyzing channels and creators that you do not personally own or manage.
